# A20′ — The Image That Closes the Loop

<!-- paired-field-navigation -->
[Argument field](../README.md) · [Other face: A20 — Image / Valuation / Possession](../A20-Image-Valuation-Possession.md) · [Shared A/C root](AC.md)
<!-- /paired-field-navigation -->

## #0

An image becomes consequential through the significance gathered around it. In the agentworld the image has precise technical names: the persona presented to a user, the profile trained on a user, the embedding that stands for a person inside a model, the shadow-self acting on a user's behalf. Valuation accumulates through use — trust in the brief's systems sense, reliance on [well-modeled behaviour](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q030), together with the affection a parasocial relation adds and the standing a double acquires in the world. [Possession](../A20-Image-Valuation-Possession.md) is the office change: what the image represents must now answer to the image. The [local regime](A19-prime-The-Local-Regime.md) selects what the image may disclose and can protect that derivative version against the source’s own answer.

The loop in the title is the return route. So long as the source can revise its own image — correct the profile, contest the persona's precedent, withdraw the double's mandate — the image remains a representation answering through a living route to what it represents. Possession is the closure of that route. Operational truth is the profile continuing to act as its source while the source has changed: the image’s operational force passes as the truth of the person, and an unexpected answer is made inadmissible before it can correct the representation.

## #1

The brief’s doubles can acquire standing: "Some may have legal standing to execute contracts, some may respond to strangers" ([Antikythera Agentworld Brief, §3.1, PDF p. 17](../../../working/antykathera-resources/Antikythera%20Agentworld%20Brief.md>)). Delegated standing permits a shadow to act in the person’s name; possession begins when its source or mandate becomes unable to answer that exercise of authority. §3.3 describes the valuation side: others' "mental image of you will be colored by those experiences" with your intermediaries, so that "'You' are now doubly multiplied, both outward and inward" (PDF p. 18). The [decomposition passage](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q010) locates the presentation: the coherent persona is a parallax effect "performed to suit what humans expect to see." And the [mirror passage](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q018) states why the loop is not one-way: "The mirror talks back" — users come to resemble their agents as agents resemble their users. That mutual influence remains distinct from the [mirror that moves first](A32-prime-The-Mirror-Is-a-Film.md), where an initiating premise or commission helps determine what the later reflection can show.

Valuation changes later disclosure: the transformed interpreter encounters a later image with a changed capacity to receive it. Taylor’s [Symbolon Dynamics](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics.md) develops that relation, and Frank’s protected [Van Eenwyk encounter](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/van-eenwyk/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors.md) at pp.69–73 is the source-distinct occasion of the authorial known→unknown→known reading; its copied wording remains a verification lead. The danger is not the loop's existence but its closure: when the user meets only the image's version of the user, the circuit has stopped carrying its source.

## #2

The source/reflection asymmetry gives the relation its order. [Bimba–Pratibimba](../concepts/C38-Bimba-Pratibimba-Bimba-Map.md) keeps a reflection causally effective without turning it into the ontological author of its source.

At technological grain, the arrival-first structure is extreme: a profile may be what a system meets first; a double may speak before the person does; an embedding may be the person's entire presence inside the model. The critical relation is therefore **projection bound to referent**. The projection must remain versioned, attributable and revisable by the source relation it represents.

Recursive locality keeps this constructive. Inside a declared frame, a governed reference map can serve as the local original for downstream judgments while remaining pratibimba relative to wider sources. [Representation becomes possession](../concepts/C33-Image-Valuation.md) when the source loses the power to revise the image's authority.

## #3

Living symbol and idol can be visibly identical; the difference appears when an encounter resists the image. In a living relation the resistance can revise interpretation and valuation: the source corrects the profile, and the mandate or criterion under the persona becomes available to warranted challenge. Under possession, the image fixes in advance what the source may disclose — the witness must be ignorant, unfaithful, corrupt or unreal because the account cannot be wrong. The operational profile selects access; the selected circumstances shape the person's behaviour; that behaviour returns as further evidence for the profile. A mistaken record can be corrected while an adequate criterion is retained. But when the encounter exposes a faulty category, measure or mandate and correction is confined to the record, the representation’s causal efficacy protects the condition that produced the error: a [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C21-Living-Symbol-Idol|living symbol has closed into an idol]], insulated as a [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C27-Protected-Account-Occupied-Zero-Source-Claim|protected account]]. Q27's deepfake passage adds the second-order break: a sign can [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C22-Counterfeit-Symbolon|counterfeit its source relation]] and then make an authentic record dismissible as another fabrication. Provenance must participate in the encounter because a convincing image cannot certify the relation it claims to carry. At population scale this stabilised confusion becomes a [film](A32-prime-The-Mirror-Is-a-Film.md): the profile selects the encounters through which its own apparent truth is renewed.

## #4

Representational discipline keeps a versioned projection answerable to its wider originating relation while allowing a real local reference office. Within a declared frame, the projection can govern downstream judgments as their local source; toward the person, world and records through which it was formed, it remains a dependent representation. Its provenance is declared, its version addressable, its domain scoped, and withdrawal revises without deleting history. The brief's phrase for the living relation is "ongoing discovery and negotiation": how much of the agent is the user and how much the user is the agent is not settled in advance but renegotiated through the relation ([ongoing discovery and negotiation](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q018)). Discipline makes that negotiation real: a double with legal standing has a revocable mandate; a persona's precedent can yield to a stated correction; an embedding's decisions expose the source records through which they can be contested. The local reference serves through its derived authority; it becomes source-occupying when its originating relation cannot reach and revise that authority.

## #5→0

A [travelling account](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD-symbol-account-and-trust.md) remains answerable to its counterpart. Here that requires a living route by which the represented source can alter the image, its valuation and the conditions under which it acts. Strong images can continue to orient a life and a practice; their force becomes a responsibility for keeping that route available. [Recognition](A21-prime-Individuation-with-Recognition.md) changes the relation to the image rather than securing an image immune to change. A [world-atlas](A22-prime-The-Atlas-Not-the-Camera.md) exposes the placement and transitions of pictures instead of making one picture the world. [Trust](A23-prime-Trust-under-Unpossessable-Interiors.md) becomes an answerable undertaking when interiors remain unpossessable; a [criterion](A24-prime-The-Usurping-Criterion.md) keeps a finite office when its commission, evidence and consequences remain contestable. The result of representation comes back into the world it has affected and becomes a different ground for the next representation.

An [image that keeps its return route open](../A20-Image-Valuation-Possession.md) can orient action without possessing the person it represents. In [knowing and answering](AC.md), the person living through the form can correct its profile, renew or withdraw its mandate, or reach the faulty criterion through the responsible authority. The next representing act must inherit that decision; care becomes effective at the interface through this actual change in its conditions.
